title: Book 3 — Thalia, Chapter 414
paragraphs: After this Cambyses planned three separate expeditions: one against the Carthaginians, another against the Ammonians, and a third against the “Long-lived” Ethiopians, who dwell in that part of Libya bordering the Southern Sea. In forming these plans, he resolved to send his naval force against the Carthaginians, a body chosen from his land army against the Ammonians, and as for the Ethiopians, to send spies first, both to see whether the so-called Table of the Sun truly existed among these Ethiopians, and in addition to this to spy out everything else as well — pretending, however, to be bearers of gifts for their king.
